base_member_text: [L7] (LOW/path-quoting) The rmdir command leaves the %2\mpich path unquoted even though the same script accepts a SolutionDir/TargetDir path that may contain spaces.
audit_member_text: [L7,L13,L20,L28,L33] (MED/path-quoting) Deletion and XCOPY destination paths use raw unquoted %2, so space-containing target paths can be split or misinterpreted.

base_member_text: [L9-L23] (MED/architecture-selection) For a 32-bit build on a 64-bit machine, if the x86 MPICH2 installation is absent the fallback copies C:\Program Files\MPICH2, which is likely the 64-bit installation, into the Win32 target without validating its architecture.

audit_member_text: [L9-L23] (LOW/conditional-logic) The ELSE belongs to the inner platform test, so a machine without Program Files (x86) never tries the documented default Program Files installation.

[L7,L13-L14,L20-L21,L28-L29,L33] (MED/destructive-staging) Existing MPICH files are removed before replacement succeeds, and failed local copies return immediately instead of trying bundled dependencies.
[L9,L26,L32-L33] (LOW/argument-validation) Platform is compared unquoted and unvalidated, so missing arguments produce malformed IF commands and unknown platforms fall through to Win32 dependencies.
